channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Scientists find large heat anomaly deep within Mars
item.description: Mars exhibits a hidden temperature divide, with its southern interior potentially hundreds of degrees hotter than the north and partially molten, according to new findings.

item.title: HEPA purifiers may enhance brain function within a month
item.description: Adults aged 40 and older showed about 12% faster performance on an executive function test after using a HEPA air purifier at home for one month, suggesting potential cognitive benefits.

item.title: Hundreds of hidden earthquakes detected at Antarctica's Doomsday Glacier
item.description: Researchers found 245 previously unnoticed seismic events near the Thwaites Glacier's marine edge, among hundreds of hidden quakes.

item.title: Strange 'spacetime crystal' can suddenly become a black hole
item.description: Physicists have mathematically described a bizarre spacetime crystal that may dissolve or collapse into a microscopic black hole after a brief period.
